ops.title: tooling_nudge misfire fixes shipped: #236 (12.75.0) + #239 (12.75.2)
ops.body: #236 (71d7e544): refusal verbs scope both sourcing and repeat matching; tool-output-only sourcing; lanes recorded at spawn by tooling-lane marker or Agent name; GitHub quota records expire at rate-limited-until or +1h; 12.73 state dropped by schema. #239 (33e2e063): raw-fallback records key on the first ccx/gt/gh/orca/cc-slack call only. Released v12.75.2 (v12.75.1 was #237 only). Installed: app build 12.75.2, daemonkit tool env, uv tool, user plugin, brew. Open: ccx cleanup job 18da8c541ba05f70-92b23d parked (EPERM inspecting codex-ask pid 88396) for worktree raw-verbs-first-party; retro.py-foreground guard blocks every backgrounded Bash call (reported to hooks-overzealous-sweep). Autobump guards captain-hook: releases are manual v* tags on a non-[skip ci] commit.
